title: Compliance Gatekeeper: Sprint Commitments & Release Gates for SOC2/ISO
creator: Sara Liu
description: Create a prescriptive, sprint-aligned gate system for SOC2 and ISO27001 readiness across Hosted, Dedicated and Private deployments. This ticket consolidates gate criteria, sprint commitments, responsible owners and evidence checklists so releases can be validated by Compliance and Legal before go‑live. Goal: reduce last‑minute blocking items by 80% and make go/no‑go decisions deterministic.
acceptance_criteria: Gate definitions (alpha/beta/GA) documented with explicit evidence list
Per-sprint owners and engineering estimates agreed and scheduled
Confluence playbook published and linked in release checklist
Automated evidence collection points identified (audit logs, config exports, test artifacts)
Sign-off process tested in a dry run for platform-2025.04
tasks: Inventory required evidence for SOC2 sections CC6, CC7 and ISO control A.12 (owner: Aisha)
Define SSO/SAML validation checklist and vendor matrix (owner: Miguel Hernandez)
Audit-log schema finalization and retention policy alignment with Legal (owner: Priya Rao)
Map required infra changes to ENG tickets and confirm capacity (owner: ENG lead)
Create Confluence compliance gate playbook and link to release checklist (owner: PM)
Schedule dry-run sign-off meeting mid-cycle and capture gaps (owner: Sara Liu)
